full_prompt_en: A square staged photographic image shows a single man leaning through a rectangular opening in a weathered blue wall. The wall fills almost the whole frame, its matte blue paint chipped in scattered pale patches and marked by scratches and stains. A narrow dark wooden frame surrounds the opening near the upper center. Through it appears a bright blue sky with low white clouds and a thin darker horizon; no room beyond the wall is visible. The man stands with his back to the viewer on a reddish-brown suitcase positioned directly below the opening. He wears a loose dark gray jacket, black trousers, and dark shoes. His head bends forward into the opening so that only a small dark cap or hair shape and a pale strip of neck are seen. One hand grips or rests near the left lower edge of the frame, and his bent legs make his balance on the case look slightly precarious. The suitcase has worn corners and a shallow handle shape, and it sits on a pale horizontal stone ledge crossing the entire lower frame. Beneath that ledge, a strip of block-like masonry is just visible. Light enters from the right, brightening the wall near the window and giving the figure a dark cast shadow to its right. The sky inside the opening is much clearer and more saturated than the aged wall, creating a visual contrast between flat exterior surface and apparent depth. The image is sparse, with large areas of chipped blue negative space around one small, awkward human action. The overall composition is quiet and absurd, using simple geometry, weathered texture, and a tiny glimpse of open distance to make the scene feel suspended.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形摆拍式摄影图像呈现一名男子从风化蓝墙的一道矩形开口向外探身。墙面几乎填满全幅，哑光蓝漆散布剥落的浅色斑块、刮痕与污渍。上部中央附近，一道窄深色木框围出开口。洞外是明亮蓝天、低低白云和细薄的较深地平线；看不到墙后房间。男子背对观看者，站在开口正下方的一只赤褐色手提箱上。他穿宽松深灰外套、黑裤和深色鞋。头向前弯入开口，只露出小小的深色帽子或头发形状与一条浅色后颈。一只手抓着或搭在窗框左下缘，弯曲的双腿让他站在箱上的平衡略显不稳。箱子边角磨损，有浅浅把手形状，置于横过下部画幅的浅色水平石台上。石台下方仅露出一道块状砌石。光从右侧进入，照亮窗旁墙面，也让人物右侧投下深影。开口中的天空比陈旧墙面更清晰、更饱和，形成平坦外墙与表面上纵深之间的视觉对照。图像疏朗，一件小而笨拙的人的动作周围是大片剥落的蓝色负空间。整体构图安静而荒诞，借简单几何、风化肌理与远方开阔空间的一小瞥让场景显得悬置。
style_prompt_en: The staged photographic treatment uses plain geometric framing and a large weathered matte color field. Dusty blue and gray occupy most of the picture, punctured by one clearer saturated rectangle and a small warm brown accent near the bottom. Chipped paint, stains, rough plaster, and hairline scratches give the broad field specific physical texture without filling it with clutter. A compact dark form is centered low against the much larger pale wall, making scale and isolation immediately apparent. Straight vertical and horizontal edges create a stable grid, while the form's uneven silhouette introduces a slight comic imbalance. Directional daylight from one side produces a concise cast shadow and makes the opening appear deeper than the surrounding flat plane. Detail remains sharp enough to reveal material wear but avoids glossy finish. The overall effect is minimal, surreal, and quietly humorous, relying on negative space and one impossible-seeming spatial relationship.
style_prompt_zh: 这种摆拍摄影处理使用朴素几何围框和大片风化的哑光色域。灰尘感蓝色与灰色占据画面大部，一道更清晰饱和的矩形开口与下部一小块暖棕色打破它。剥落漆面、污渍、粗灰泥和细裂纹赋予宽阔色域具体的物理肌理，却没有塞满杂物。一个紧凑深色形体在远大于自身的浅墙前靠下居中，使尺度与孤立感立即可见。笔直竖横边缘形成稳定网格，不齐整的剪影则引入轻微滑稽的失衡。来自一侧的定向日光形成简短投影，让开口看上去比周围平面更深。细节清晰到足以显露材料磨损，却没有光亮完成面。整体效果极简、超现实且带安静幽默，依靠负空间与一处仿佛不可能的空间关系。
theme_en: A man leaning through a window in a weathered blue wall
theme_zh: 一名男子从风化蓝墙的窗洞向外探身
name: Teun Hocks
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
